35756412.model_description: A CNN-based super-resolution algorithm takes standard MRI images as input and outputs higher-resolution images with improved peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity, intended to sharpen brain MRI used to diagnose and monitor severe viral encephalitis in children. It was compared against fully-connected and recurrent neural network super-resolution methods and combined with a nursing transition-care intervention.
35756412.headline_result: SR-CNN PSNR 40.08 dB / SSIM 0.98 vs FNN 38.01 dB/0.93 and RNN 37.21 dB/0.93; diagnostic sensitivity 95.34%, specificity 75%, accuracy 94.44% vs conventional MRI 81.40%/50%/80%
